text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Osaka Hai has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove entered this race expecting to face off against her rival, but it turns out Silence Suzuka is not running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nonetheless, Air Groove heads to the track determined to give a race worthy of the Empress name.
